title: Find All Duplicates in an Array
description:
[Source: LeetCode 442]
Given an integer array nums of length n where all the integers of nums are in the range [1, n] and each integer appears once or twice, return an array of all the integers that appears twice in O(n) runtime and O(1) space.

Input Format:
First line: n
Second line: n space-separated integers

Output Format:
Space-separated integers appearing twice in ascending order
